lines.zh: 我四条短腿走，尾巴在后面拖。
lines.en: Four short legs. Tail dragging behind.

lines.zh: 我在河滩上走，脚是湿的。
lines.en: Walking the riverbank. Wet feet.
Not fast. Steady.
Fins standing on my back.

lines.zh: 我摆着尾巴，沿着河岸游。
lines.en: Tail swinging, I swim along the riverbank.
Around the stones. Over sand.
I head toward water.
My walk has a two-beat rhythm.

lines.zh: 我走到沼泽边上，停了一下。
lines.en: At the swamp edge, I pause.

lines.zh: 我身上的绿色在草丛里不太显。
lines.en: My green fades into the grass.

lines.zh: 我走在你后面，有点距离。
lines.en: Behind you, at a little distance.
I come up off the beach.
I lie by the water. Fins drying.
A Rookie-level Digimon.

lines.zh: 我的数据在慢慢稳下来。
lines.en: My data settling.
I open my mouth and try a sound.
Movement in the water. I watch.

lines.zh: 我甩头，水珠甩到石头上。
lines.en: I shake my head; droplets fly onto the stones.
Damp here. Suits me.
I wander near here. Not far.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一下一下拍地。
lines.en: My tail taps the ground.

lines.zh: 我在等进化，虽然不知道什么时候。
lines.en: Waiting to evolve. No idea when.
I lift a forepaw and groom my fins.

lines.zh: 有鱼跳了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: A fish jumped. I saw it.
Sleepy. Sunbathing.
I sniff the water. Fresh.
Are you my Tamer?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛是圆的。
lines.en: I look up. Round eyes.
River water on your sleeve.
Head tilted. My fins tilt too.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，我把头凑过去。
lines.en: Your hand comes near. I lean in.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我很好奇。
lines.en: I don't know you. Curious, though.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才看得舒服。
lines.en: Crouch down. Better at my height.
Small teeth. I don't bite.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我浮上来看看。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank; I surface to look.

lines.zh: 我这样看着你，是等你伸手。
lines.en: I look at you, waiting for a hand.
You smiled. I opened my mouth too.
No hostility between us.
Half a step back. Then a little closer.
You're warm. The water's cold.
I've remembered the mud on your boots.
Call and I'll answer.
I back away. Fins up.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我数据里有记录。
lines.en: Minor damage. Logged in my data.
I slipped. Held.

lines.zh: 鳍边破了个口，游起来发飘。
lines.en: A tear in my fin makes my swimming drift.
I shake my head. Still clear.
Stop. It hurts.
I retreat to the water's edge.
A negative value logged in my data.
I can still move. It's fine.
Water came over. Cooler now.
Seafood! I smell it.

lines.zh: 海鲜味，隔着水我都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell seafood even through the water.
Fish. I like fish.
Lower your hand. Can't reach.
Feed me and I'll warm to you.
A bit fishy. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我一口吞下，连水都咽了。
lines.en: I gulp it down, water and all.
After this, I'll follow you.
Don't take it. I want more.
By the water. I'll get it myself.
That smell makes me want the water.

lines.zh: 你指缝里的碎虾，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the shrimp bits between your fingers.
Slick with slime, I slip from your grip.
I'm wet. Don't rub.
This low. You nearly stepped on me.
I go around, back to the water.
One bump. I tilted.
I back off. Fins raised.
Wet ground. I slid a bit.

lines.zh: 尾巴被踩，我甩了一身水。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail. I splashed you.

lines.zh: 我们靠太近，你身上有铁味。
lines.en: Too close. Iron on you.

lines.zh: 我个头小，游得比走得快。
lines.en: Small as I am, I swim faster than I walk.
I'm young. That's a long way off.
Let's just travel together.
Touch my back and I'll lie down.
On the riverbank, I walk blowing bubbles.
That isn't in my data.
When I grow legs, we'll talk.
Stand back. Water on my fins.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着河底的沙。
lines.en: We lie side by side on the riverbed sand.
Don't swim off. Wait for me.
Let's go back to the water together.
I pick it up in my mouth.
Not seafood. No interest.
I lift it. Fins spread.

lines.zh: 沙里还有几个，我扒出来。
lines.en: More in the sand. I dig them out.
Yours. I'll bring it over.
I bit it — too hard, my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 我用鳍扒开沙，把它盖住。
lines.en: I scrape the sand with my fin and cover it.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞不下，我用前爪推。
lines.en: Won't fit my mouth. I push it.
It rings. I find that fun.

lines.zh: 贝塔兽的海鲜，放你脚边。
lines.en: Betamon's seafood set by your feet.

lines.zh: 水底的影子一晃，我追上去。
lines.en: A shadow shifts on the bottom and I give chase.

lines.zh: 泥里冒出一串泡，是活的。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the mud — something's alive.
That's not a fish. Hostile.
Low to the ground, holding breath underwater.
You're behind me. I'll guard.
I can close that.
It's looking for a gap.
Fins up. I've fixed on it.

lines.zh: 水边对我不利，我换位置。
lines.en: Bad ground near water. I shift.
Faster than me. Need to think.

lines.zh: 嘴里的泡泡已经鼓起来了。
lines.en: Bubbles swell in my mouth.
The moment the water breaks.
I turn, step by step.

lines.zh: 我在水草间跟着它的尾迹。
lines.en: I follow its wake through the weeds.
My fins spread wide.
Bubbles gather in my mouth.
Counting its moves.

lines.zh: 这条浅滩，我游过一百次。
lines.en: I've swum this shallows a hundred times.
It took my flank. I turn.
My tail keeps me steady.
Keep retreating and you're in the water.
Head up. Ready to spit.
It likely fears water too.
Only a puddle between us.
I spat a string of bubbles.
I rammed its legs.
Light, but on target.
It fell back. So did I.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，往水里拖。
lines.en: I bite its fin and drag it into the water.
I flick my tail. Water sprays.
That made me slip too.
I slap the water with my tail and knock it aside.
I turned. Not fast enough.
You're behind me. I'm watching.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，准备再来一次。
lines.en: Crouched. Ready again.

lines.zh: 我把水搅起来，它看不清我。
lines.en: I stir the water so it loses sight of me.

lines.zh: 从沼泽里爬上来，身上都是水。
lines.en: Up from the swamp, still dripping.
Still dripping.
I shake. Fins out.
A swamp. I like it.

lines.zh: 我在锚点附近转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle near my anchor point.
I was born by a river.
I look up. Bright sky.
I open my mouth and try a call.
This shallows will do. Staying.
A film of water on me.

lines.zh: 我从海滩的沙里钻出来。
lines.en: I come out of the beach sand.
My first sight of dry land.

lines.zh: 火烤过来，我身上的水冒气。
lines.en: Fire. The water on me steams.
Fell. Landed on my belly.
The water's too deep; my gills tighten.

lines.zh: 我被掀到岸上，拼命弹跳。
lines.en: Blown onto the bank, I thrash and flop.
I crawl from the river into the marsh.
Unknown data. It hurts.

lines.zh: 没有海鲜，我的数据在掉。
lines.en: No seafood. My data is dropping.

lines.zh: 闪电顺着水面爬到我身上。
lines.en: Lightning crawls across the surface onto me.
Falling. No water either.
